card.name: Decimal point after the digit 1
card.fires_on: The decimal point right after a leading "1" in a number such as 1.3, 1.5 or 1.8, in dose ranges, measurements and statistics. Weaker on the "0" after "0.".

modes.label: Decimal after 1
modes.description: The period following a leading 1 inside a number, before the next digit.

modes.label: Zero after 0.
modes.description: The zero right after "0." in a table of small values.

card.plain: It lights up on the decimal point in numbers like 1.5, just before the digit after the point.
